decisions.reason: As a large, experienced German machinery maker, the firm has enough related engineering and integration knowledge to improve a manual laser marking workstation, but the weaker 2023 web presence suggests it is a more tentative, niche offer than the printer lines.

A high-resolution thermal inkjet printer fits well with industrial machinery and marking capabilities, and the dedicated 2023 product page signals commitment and sufficient internal knowledge to learn from early market feedback and refine it.

The piezo inkjet printer is technologically somewhat more demanding than thermal inkjet, but for a large incumbent with broad absorptive capacity and a clear market presentation in 2023 it is still more likely to be developed further than withdrawn quickly.
